There is a general delivery service point located in the  northern part of the campus behind Zijing Apartment  Building 14. For students, all deliveries made to an on- campus dormitory address will be sent to this site, where  parcels and packages can be collected. Parcels can also be  sent from the service station.

There are several photo studios located on campus. One  is located in C Building, one in the Zhao lan yuan area,  and another is in the shop area to the east of Guanchou  Yuan canteen. They provide photo printing and other  photography related services.
